groups.source: All five ONNX files exactly match codexxx/pocket-tts-web revision 6fbae64699d94f60dde9c3975984b383a6a3d950. Tokenizer, voices.bin and sentencepiece.js match KevinAHM/pocket-tts-web revision 3cf6daa623e2b09992c972cab32568ee8679a154; tokenizer also matches Kyutai revision 492522650173a0653b7575cdc25ae09810e5d741. Both web snapshots include a CC-BY-NC-4.0 ONNX-LICENSE despite README CC-BY-4.0. For the initial release, the owner elects to comply with the stricter CC-BY-NC-4.0 terms and confirms the desktop app is entirely free, has no paid product or connected service, is not a lead-generation path, and does not monetize data. Replace the exports or obtain commercial permission before any monetized distribution. Exact byte matches and this initial-use decision are not the final hash-bound inventory approval.
